environment.description: Same Lambda deployed behind API Gateway WebSocket API with the following configuration: The $connect route has a request parameter validation requirement where 'route.request.querystring.token' is marked as required. The 'sendMessage' route integration has a Model Selection Expression of '$request.body.action' and a request model bound to the route with content-type 'application/json' referencing a JSON Schema (draft-04) model named 'SendMessageModel' stored in the API with the following schema: {type: object, required: [action, targetUserId, message], properties: {action: {type: string, enum: [sendMessage]}, targetUserId: {type: string, pattern: '^[a-f0-9-]{36}$', maxLength: 36}, message: {type: string, maxLength: 500}}, additionalProperties: false}. Route response selection expression is set to $default. The API stage has a throttle configuration of 100 requests/second per connection. Note: API Gateway WebSocket APIs validate the model on the integration request and return a GoneException (status 410) to the client if the payload does not conform, but this validation occurs AFTER the route selection — meaning the Lambda is never invoked with non-conforming payloads on the sendMessage route.
